Name: Sir Robert's Vibrant Flower Mania
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]My newest mod features 10 additional flowers via the Content Patcher to fulfill your decorating dreams in Stardew Valley! Each flower has a selection of vases to choose from via Alternative Textures. There are poppies, daisies, a red peony...and I've even attempted to create a marigold, which proved to be more difficult than I anticipated. It looks more like a daisy in my personal opinion, but I still like it.[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4] [/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b][u]Installation[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into the [/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Stardew Valley/Mods folder. When you play the game, the images can be located in the Decor/Houseplant section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b][u]Main features[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Images #1 through #10 consists of flowers that can be placed upon [u]end tables[/u]. Each flower has additional images via Alternative Textures with a selection of vases [/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]to choose from.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Image #11 consists of flowers that can be placed upon [u]kitchen countertops[/u] and [u]square cocktail tables[/u]. There are 2 of each image - one has been moved up a few pixels to fit best upon [u]kitchen countertops[/u] and the other has been moved down a few pixels to best align upon [u]square cocktail tables[/u]. They can also fit on some end tables that have a slightly different "alignment". Give one of these a try![/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Requires Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b][u]Shout outs[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]I used end tables, square cocktail tables and kitchen countertops by PlatinumCats, Orangeblossom7, stardust, lululovely, Endylau, riruru57 and atlasphere. I also used furniture from the Stardew Valley game. Please check out the pictures to see all the examples. [/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Please enjoy and have fun decorating![/size][/color]
